verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single homepage snippet, 'Resize an image to 800px wide', which suggests Netlify can resize images natively. Nothing describes how on-demand transformation works, what optimizations it applies, or that it is a CDN-backed image service. The media integration listing (intdir-10) is a third-party listing, not a built-in feature, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a built-in image CDN, format/quality optimization details, the on-demand URL/API transformation mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
